verified_requirements.note: Character and creature traits are preserved: dragon silent, no magic, hatchling hides. The cord is an added detail but consistent with the ending.
The stair obstruction is shown by the mother's attempt, the grille floods, and the upper room stays dry.
The compass is not returned, no reward is given, the rescue uses no hidden means, and the mother and hatchling end up safe above.
Mother and hatchling reunite in the dry upper room; no false either-or choice is set up after the compass is lost.
The theft, the scattered papers, Ekin giving chase, and Duru redirecting her to the lighthouse glint are all shown.
The compass is with the dragon and both girls head out together from the harbour.
Duru chooses the coast path, Ekin wants the shorter shore, Duru shows the tide line, Ekin accepts reluctantly, and they enter by the open door.
They are in the dry upper room and the path home has been shown.
Wind sounds, salt-clouded glass, shiny items in the nest, the compass, the hatchling, Duru's request to wait, Ekin's defiance, the stair and wave sound are all shown.
Everyone is in the upper room with the compass on the nest, and the stair is located.
Ekin reaches, the mother drives her off, the compass rolls down, the hatchling flees, the mother jams, Duru does not push anyone, and a wave sweeps the compass out through the grille.
The compass is lost to the sea, the mother is above, the hatchling is below, and the exit remains usable.

Ekin fixates on the grille, Duru urges leaving, Ekin owns the fault and asks for help, Duru stays, Ekin crouches with the jacket and Duru stands one step higher; the hatchling comes up and both climb back.
Children and hatchling reach the dry upper room and meet the mother; the compass is still lost.
The mother covers the hatchling with a wing, does not speak, thank them or return anything; the girls take the same path home, Ekin follows Duru without arguing and Duru does not mock her.
The last image is Ekin turning the empty cord in her pocket and catching up with Duru, after deciding to tell the truth; loss and the change between them are both felt.
The cord snapped and stayed behind at the harbour (S005), so it could be hanging from her wrist, but this is not an impossibility. It is later tucked into her pocket consistently.

findings.exact_text: which had somehow stayed looped through her belt loop when everything else had been swept away
findings.reason: The cord is never established as detached from the compass or as being on her belt; S008 says the dragon's claws closed around the cord and wrenched it free. The 'somehow' leaves the survival of the cord unexplained.
